senses.sense_definition: de eigenschap of toestand dat iets gebaseerd is op willekeur, zonder vaste regels of patronen

examples.text: De burger klaagde over de <w>willekeurigheid</w> waarmee de nieuwe regels werden toegepast door de ambtenaren.

target_lang_translations.en: The citizen complained about the <w>arbitrariness</w> with which the new rules were applied by the officials.

examples.text: Vanwege de <w>willekeurigheid</w> van de signalen kon er geen logisch patroon ontdekt worden in het experiment.

target_lang_translations.en: Due to the <w>randomness</w> of the signals, no logical pattern could be discovered in the experiment.

target_lang_definitions.en: the quality or state of being arbitrary or random, without fixed rules or patterns

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: based on whim, discretion, or lack of standard rules
lacking a pattern or principle of organization
